description: Quote repaying debt. 'auto' repays from collateral via a flash-loan swap and requires slippage; 'manual' repays from the wallet. Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal: 0.005 means 0.5% (not 1e18 fixed-point)

name: quote_repay
title: Quote repay
